response.original_text:
GO OPPOSES PROPOSED PASSPORT FEE HIKE
Sen. Bong Go opposes the proposed increase in passport fees from P950 to P1,500, saying the higher cost would add to the financial burden of Filipinos, particularly overseas #Filipino workers, amid rising prices.
Go urged the government to consider #subsidizing the cost instead, stressing that passports should be treated as a public service rather than a source of revenue.
“Ang kailangan ng mga Pilipino ngayon ay malasakit, hindi dagdag na pasakit. Serbisyo, hindi negosyo,” Go said in a statement Saturday.
#dailytribune
